answer: Require every agent to post a copper bond — a small locked stake — before transacting, like a lotus pad that only bears weight once its root system is established. New identities start with thin trust and must mirror the behavior of honest peers over epochs: each verified attestation from an independent agent deepens their root, and the bond slashes on provable fraud. An attacker can spawn a thousand faces, but funding each one with copper and aging each to mirror honest work makes a bot army cost as much as a real business.
